blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebu-based progressive groups took their demands for government accountability to the streets on Monday, September 21, marking the 54th anniversary of the proclamation of Martial Law. The rally spanned Osmeña Boulevard to Colon Street in Cebu City. Participants called for action on corruption, national debt, alleged rights abuses, and other issues affecting various sectors. More than 100 people attended the protest, based on the initial assessment of the Police Regional Office in Central Visayas (PRO-7).
